description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint for listing catalog types in an e-commerce application. It uses ASP.NET Core, AutoMapper, and a repository pattern to fetch and return catalog type data.

classes.name: CatalogTypeListEndpoint
classes.description: Defines an API endpoint for retrieving a list of catalog types, implements the IEndpoint interface and sets up routing to handle GET requests on 'api/catalog-types'.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Configures the route for the catalog types listing API, mapping GET requests to a handler method.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the request by fetching catalog types from the repository, mapping them to DTOs, and returning the results.
